question: What should the mountain protector make auspicious and not injure?
premises: The verse names the mountain protector.
It asks him to make that auspicious.
It forbids injuring man and world.
inference: The speaker asks the mountain protector to make things auspicious and not injure man or world.
uncertainties: The exact object of make is unclear.
plain_english: O mountain protector, make that auspicious; do not injure man or world.
